text:
olivia: hey! accepted the org invite, 2FA is set up with an authenticator app, but when I try to create a repo under the org I get: "You don't have permission to create repositories in redwood-inference." I need a sandbox for the first-day walkthrough.

[devex-bot]: GitHub Invite Event 1991234567: accepted for olivia (olivia@workmail.com). Note: repo creation in org may be restricted to specific teams or admins.

sam: welcome olivia! quick checklist: 1) confirm you show as Member on org page, 2) check if you can create a repo under your own user account (should be allowed), 3) some orgs require being in a team like `dev-sandbox` to get repo creation rights.

olivia: I am Member, can create personal repos but need the sandbox inside the org so mentors can add reviewers.

sam: ok. we usually create a bare org repo and grant you admin on it. pinging peopleops to open a repo-request.

peopleops-bot: Created ticket PO-4982: org-repo-request for olivia. Please include repo name and brief purpose.

olivia: repo name `onboard/olivia-sandbox`, purpose: onboarding exercises and infra walkthrough.

kevin: adding a note: org policy requires repos to have a CODEOWNERS file and default branch protection even for sandbox. i can scaffold it after creation. also confirm SAML SSO is authorized if the repo is private.

sam: peopleops will create it private and add you to `dev-sandbox` team with admin rights. give it a few minutes.

peopleops-bot: PO-4982 updated: repo `onboard/olivia-sandbox` created, team assignment queued.

olivia: trying to access the new repo URL gives 403 still.

kevin: sometimes team membership sync lags. can you paste your GH handle?

olivia: handle is olivia-eng.

sam: adding olivia-eng to dev-sandbox now.

peopleops-bot: Team sync job queued for olivia-eng (job id: 91012).

olivia: refreshed and can access repo now, can push and create a branch. thanks! :thumbsup:

kevin: left a minimal CODEOWNERS + branch-protection scaffold in main. you should be able to open PRs for exercises. if anything else blocks, ping #eng-ops.

sam: note for onboarding docs: add a step to request an org sandbox repo via peopleops-bot to avoid confusion for new hires who need org-scoped repos.
